answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked stake that is slashed if peers attest misbehaviour, and to build reputation only through slow, verified work over successive epochs. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones must fund each one and wait out the same proving period, so the cost scales linearly: no saffron shortcut, no timber pile of fake accounts, and no cipher trick can bypass the wait, while honest participants keep their standing cheaply through consistent, checkable contributions.
